levels.surface: أبو كامل فضيل بن حسين الجحدري

notes: The dashed «واللفظ لأبي كامل» is a gloss and is left out.
«حدثنا يزيد» after the gloss is the same man as «يزيد، بن زريع»: one link, the fuller form (rule 7).
Ibn Mas'ud's report of the man's question and the Prophet's answer is the saying; he is the last link.
